title: Descent of the upper local tower over a prescribed directed base system
statement: Let R → S → S′ be local homomorphisms of local rings, F : I ⥤ CommRingCat a nonempty directed preorder diagram of local rings, and π₀ : F ⟶ const R a colimit cocone with local component and transition maps. Assume each F(i) is essentially of finite type over ℤ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Supply localization presentations of S over R and of S′ over S, each with finitely presented presenting algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and a fixed s-by-t finite free cokernel presentation of an S′-module M. Then there is a nonempty directed Λ and a final functor J : Λ ⥤ I such that, with the prescribed base system A = J ⋙ F and the prescribed base cocone π.app i = π₀.app (J.obj i), one obtains local middle and top diagrams Bs, C, natural local structure maps and compatible colimit cocones to S and S′, and a module diagram D in the same universe as M with semilinear maps and colimit M. The middle and top maps are essentially of finite type; each D(i) has a cokernel presentation with s columns and t rows. Transition and limit ring scalar extensions of the middle and top rings are localizations, with their maps specified on pure tensors; the corresponding module scalar extensions are linear equivalences with the prescribed semilinear pure-tensor formulas. The full clauses and independent universes are written verbatim in lean.statement below. This result does not construct the base system or supply the presentation of S′ over S.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Tag 00R7, first paragraph (two applications of the constructions of Tags 00QV and 00QX), and first sentence of the second paragraph (tensor comparisons).

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-limit-module-essentially-finite-presentation-over-system] to F and its prescribed colimit cocone, descending S with the empty 0-by-0 matrix and its concrete cokernel. Identify the auxiliary ring maps with the supplied cocone components by extensionality. Obtain the first directed tail and the middle diagram with ring localization comparisons.

Compose the essentially finite type maps to show that the middle stage rings are essentially of finite type over Z [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-limit-module-small-over-system] to this middle system, the supplied presentation of S′ over S, and the given matrix presentation of M. Obtain the top ring and module data on a second tail, directly in module universe v. Identify its auxiliary component maps by extensionality.

Construct the two monotone inclusion functors of the directed upper tails. Directedness supplies an upper bound of the cutoff and each ambient index; parallel arrows are equal because the preorder category is thin. Mathlib Functor.final_of_exists_of_isFiltered proves each inclusion final, and Functor.final_comp proves their composite final. Preserve the original base and middle cocones with Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv, the final-functor colimit transport of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-initial-full-subcategory]. Define the two natural structure transformations from the returned component ring maps, using transition compatibility for naturality. Restrict all remaining clauses along the second inclusion and assemble the witnesses, with exactly the prescribed base functor and base cocone.

theorem limit_tower_over_local_system
    {R S S' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing S']
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalRing S']
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (π₀ : F ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (CommRingCat.of R))
    (hFlocal : ∀ i, IsLocalRing (F.obj i))
    (hFmap : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
    (hπlocal : ∀ i, IsLocalHom (π₀.app i).hom)
    (hcolim : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R) π₀)))
    (hFfinite : ∀ i, Algebra.EssFiniteType ℤ (F.obj i))
    (α : R →+* S) (β : S →+* S') [IsLocalHom α] [IsLocalHom β]
    (B : Type p) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    (W : Submonoid B) (f : B →+* S) (hf : f.comp (algebraMap R B) = α)
    (hS : letI := f.toAlgebra; IsLocalization W S)
    (Q : Type q) [CommRing Q] [Algebra S Q] [Algebra.FinitePresentation S Q]
    (V : Submonoid Q) (g : Q →+* S') (hg : g.comp (algebraMap S Q) = β)
    (hS' : letI := g.toAlgebra; IsLocalization V S')
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module S' M]
    (s t : ℕ) (H : (Fin s → S') →ₗ[S'] (Fin t → S'))
    (hM : Nonempty (((Fin t → S') ⧸ LinearMap.range H) ≃ₗ[S'] M)) :
    ∃ (Λ : Type u) (_ : Preorder Λ) (_ : Nonempty Λ) (_ : IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·))
      (J : Λ ⥤ I), J.Final ∧
      let A := J ⋙ F
      let π : A ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of R) :=
        { app := fun i ↦ π₀.app (J.obj i)
          naturality := fun _ _ h ↦ π₀.naturality (J.map h) }
      ∃ (Bs C : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (ρ : A ⟶ Bs) (σ : Bs ⟶ C)
      (κ : Bs ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S))
      (κ' : C ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S'))
      (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v})
      (ν : D ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))
      (_ : ∀ i : Λ, Module (C.obj i) (D.obj i)),
      -- local rings and local homomorphisms
      (∀ i, IsLocalRing (A.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, IsLocalRing (Bs.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsLocalRing (C.obj i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsLocalHom (ρ.app i).hom) ∧ (∀ i, IsLocalHom (σ.app i).hom) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (A.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (Bs.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (C.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
      (∀ i, IsLocalHom (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of R) (π.app i))) ∧
      (∀ i, IsLocalHom (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i))) ∧
      (∀ i, IsLocalHom (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S') (κ'.app i))) ∧
      -- the maps to `R, S, S'` commute with `α, β`
      (∀ i, ρ.app i ≫ κ.app i = π.app i ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom α) ∧
      (∀ i, σ.app i ≫ κ'.app i = κ.app i ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom β) ∧
      -- semilinearity of the module maps
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j) (y : C.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom (y • x) =
          (C.map (homOfLE h)).hom y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      (∀ i (y : C.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) (y • x) =
          (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S') (κ'.app i)) y •
            (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x) ∧
      -- (1) the colimits
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R) π)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S) κ)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S') κ')) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (AddCommGrpCat.of M) ν)) ∧
      -- (2) essential finite type
      (∀ i, (algebraMap ℤ (A.obj i)).EssFiniteType) ∧
      (∀ i, (ρ.app i).hom.EssFiniteType) ∧
      (∀ i, (σ.app i).hom.EssFiniteType) ∧
      -- (3) finite generation, indeed cokernels of `t × s` matrices
      (∀ i, ∃ H₀ : (Fin s → C.obj i) →ₗ[C.obj i] (Fin t → C.obj i),
        Nonempty (((Fin t → C.obj i) ⧸ LinearMap.range H₀) ≃ₗ[C.obj i] D.obj i)) ∧
      -- (4) transition base changes
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (ρ.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (A.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ φ : Bs.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j →+* Bs.obj j,
          (∀ (x : Bs.obj i) (y : A.obj j),
            φ (x ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] y) = (Bs.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * (ρ.app j).hom y) ∧
          (letI := φ.toAlgebra
           ∃ U : Submonoid (Bs.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j), IsLocalization U (Bs.obj j))) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (σ.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (Bs.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ φ : C.obj i ⊗[Bs.obj i] Bs.obj j →+* C.obj j,
          (∀ (x : C.obj i) (y : Bs.obj j),
            φ (x ⊗ₜ[Bs.obj i] y) = (C.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * (σ.app j).hom y) ∧
          (letI := φ.toAlgebra
           ∃ U : Submonoid (C.obj i ⊗[Bs.obj i] Bs.obj j), IsLocalization U (C.obj j))) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
        letI := (C.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ e : C.obj j ⊗[C.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[C.obj j] D.obj j,
          ∀ (y : C.obj j) (x : D.obj i),
            e (y ⊗ₜ[C.obj i] x) = y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      -- (5) base changes to the limit
      (∀ i,
        letI := (ρ.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of R) (π.app i)).toAlgebra
        ∃ φ : Bs.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] R →+* S,
          (∀ (x : Bs.obj i) (y : R),
            φ (x ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] y) =
              (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)) x * α y) ∧
          (letI := φ.toAlgebra
           ∃ U : Submonoid (Bs.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] R), IsLocalization U S)) ∧
      (∀ i,
        letI := (σ.app i).hom.toAlgebra
        letI := (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S) (κ.app i)).toAlgebra
        ∃ φ : C.obj i ⊗[Bs.obj i] S →+* S',
          (∀ (x : C.obj i) (y : S),
            φ (x ⊗ₜ[Bs.obj i] y) =
              (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S') (κ'.app i)) x * β y) ∧
          (letI := φ.toAlgebra
           ∃ U : Submonoid (C.obj i ⊗[Bs.obj i] S), IsLocalization U S')) ∧
      (∀ i,
        letI := (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S') (κ'.app i)).toAlgebra
        ∃ e : S' ⊗[C.obj i] D.obj i ≃ₗ[S'] M,
          ∀ (y : S') (x : D.obj i),
            e (y ⊗ₜ[C.obj i] x) =
              y • (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M) (ν.app i)) x)
